title: Concept: Timestamp without a zone in a money record
description: A transaction timestamp with no offset or zone marker in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: An unzoned timestamp is ambiguous across the cut-off that decides the value date, and the omission usually means the server's local clock leaks into the record.
applicability: Deployments that render a transaction timestamp with no offset or zone marker into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: An unzoned timestamp is ambiguous across the cut-off that decides the value date, and the omission usually means the server's local clock leaks into the record.
